summary: git options: track_submodules to follow branch tips, umask, update to skip fetching, verify_commit for GPG-signed commits, and version (HEAD, branch, tag or SHA-1).
questions: How do I check out a specific tag with Ansible?
How do I make submodules track their branch's latest commit?
How do I verify the commit signature on checkout?
How do I stop the git module from pulling new changes?

answer_card.title: git parameters (part 4)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `version` (HEAD): branch, tag, or SHA-1 (SHA-1 may need `refspec`)
- `update` (yes): false = don't fetch new revisions
- `track_submodules` (no): like `git submodule update --remote`
- `verify_commit` (no): require GPG-signed commit (git ≥ 2.1, key in keyring)
- `umask`
